sonnet.problem: The card says "Then their own property was confiscated," which sets the confiscation after the partnering and the sympathizing with prisoners. Hebrews 10:33-34 gives no order for these events, so the card adds a time sequence the text doesn't have.
sonnet.rule: **Times stay true.** No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The question says "The writer calls it a new and living way" and "he says it was opened for us." The question never says what "it" is, and the card before it is a choice card that doesn't name the way either. The baker can't tell what the pronoun points to.
sonnet.rule: **Always give context in the question.** The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
